prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

- sign_in: 92.7%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 73.1%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 96.0%, median 201s / mean 2336s

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [choose_path, redesign] Interactive Storyboard Journey Redesign: Redesign the initial story intro screen into a story scroll layout with animated story cards that illustrate companion traits before pathway selection. (why: The choose_path stage has a high mean time (514s), indicating users stall or get distracted before selecting their journey.)
1: [sign_in, copy] Existing Account Pet Cloud Recovery Notice: Display explicit account recovery copy clarifying that signing in syncs existing pets without overwriting newly created companion profiles. (why: 8 support emails complained about pets missing or reset after signing back into their account.)
2: [adoption, hint] Pet Creation Validation Safety Hint: Add an instant verification hint on photo upload that confirms lighting and pose requirements before pet generation begins. (why: 3 support tickets report custom pet creation failures or distorted render results during adoption.)
3: [home, new_flow] Desktop Rendering Diagnostics Flow: Integrate background environment verification checks into the waiting screen that validate window overlay permissions before spawning. (why: 3 support tickets note that pets do not render on the desktop or the app fails to open after waiting.)
4: [home, notification] Desktop Spawning System Alert Switch: Enable an automated system desktop alert prompt on the waiting screen to notify users when the pet is ready to appear. (why: The mean time spent in the home step is 2336s, showing that users switch away while waiting for spawning.)
5: [finish, incentive] First Pet Interaction Reward Badge: Add a mascot achievement badge on the home intro screen that unlocks upon completing the first desktop interaction prompt. (why: Finish conversion drops to 76.1%, and users need immediate motivation to test desktop controls.)
